text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The summer training camp aiming for Tanino Gimlet's comeback was finally about to begin—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: "It strikes me as somewhat irresponsible that Tanino Gimlet's Trainer has yet to clarify their future plans, don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "Tanino Gimlet has also vanished from the public eye since the press conference. Just what could her current situation be—"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it about time we got an explanation?
Surely the fans are concerned about these matters as well?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Hahaha!! Such prickly venom!
You could rival a wicked, tyrannical king!
choice_data_list: I'm being treated completely like the bad guy here...
I've been made out to be the total villain, haven't I...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let them talk.
It will only add more color to my revival.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you prepared?
Everything will be decided by how this summer turns out.
